## What happened

Incident INC-0262 concerns an "Inappropriate record access review". The matter was recorded as beginning on 2025-06-09 and ending on 2025-06-30. The notice records a review of access to records during this period and sets out the cause and effect identified for the incident.

## Cause

The recorded cause was: Leaver kept access after a role change. This meant that access remained available after the individual’s role had changed.

## Effect

The recorded effect was: Records read without a care relationship. The incident therefore involved access to records where there was no care relationship. This notice documents the issue for review and provides a clear record of the circumstances and effect associated with INC-0262.
